channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Judicialização deve ser tática de campanha para Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The pre-campaigns of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) signal that judicialization will be a central tactic in the 2026 elections, with actions already filed at the TSE to block a film about Jair Bolsonaro and suspend a sensitive poll. While the PT will repeat its 2022 strategy, now wielding state power, the opposition seeks to counter perceptions of judicial bias by relying on Bolsonaro-appointees at the TSE and plans to use the judiciary as an offensive tool, including challenging alleged abuses of public resources by the government.

item.title: O ator de ‘Dark Horse’ que segue perfis anti-Bolsonaro nas redes
item.description: Actor José Trassi, who portrays Aurélio Barba — a dramatized version of Adélio Bispo — in the film 'Dark Horse', follows anti-Bolsonaro profiles on social media, including 'DefundBolsonaro', which criticizes the ex-president's environmental policies. Trassi also follows President Lula, deputy Érika Hilton, and left-wing humor pages, and frequently speaks out on racism, indigenous rights, and land demarcation — issues often attacked by Bolsonarism.

item.title: Lula é visto como mais experiente e Flávio como mais inovador, diz Datafolha
item.description: Lula is seen as more experienced (55%) and Flávio Bolsonaro as more innovative (31%), according to a Datafolha poll from May 2026. Lula is also perceived as more corrupt (46%) than Flávio (30%) in terms of public morality. The survey was conducted before the release of an audio in which Flávio requested funds to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula lança crédito de até R$ 30 bilhões para taxistas e motoristas de aplicativo comprarem carros novos
item.description: President Lula signed a Provisional Measure creating a credit line of up to R$ 30 billion for taxi and app-based drivers to purchase new vehicles, with special conditions and a focus on sustainable cars. The program, part of Move Brazil and operated by BNDES, requires at least 12 months of active registration and 100 rides, and will be accessible via gov.br/movebrasil starting June 19.

item.title: Ex-petista e aliada de João Campos, Marília Arraes diz não ver problema em Raquel Lyra apoiar Lula
item.description: Marília Arraes (PDT), Senate pre-candidate on João Campos' (PSB) ticket, defended Governor Raquel Lyra's (PSD) open support for Lula's re-election, criticating her 'fence-sitting' stance. She emphasized the need to unify the political field around Lula amid national polarization, while Campos seeks to nationalize his campaign as 'Lula's soldier' to push Lyra toward bolsonarism. Despite Lyra's overtures to the PT and Lula, the president has avoided taking sides, praising both as young and competent for public security.

item.title: Michelle se nega a comentar relação de Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro: ‘Você devia perguntar para ele’
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro refused to comment on the relationship between her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating the question should be directed to the senator. The controversy involves audio and messages where Flávio demands Vorcaro transfer 134 million reais to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro's life — an amount far exceeding budgets of nationally acclaimed Brazilian films.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro chama Moraes de ‘irmão em Cristo’ e cita possível conversão do ministro do STF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro referred to Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes as 'brother in Christ' during an event in Brasília, suggesting a possible conversion of the minister and citing the release of Jair Bolsonaro's hairstylist as a sign of divine intervention. She also posted on Instagram about forgiveness and divine justice, while declining to comment on the controversy involving her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro and his request for funds from Daniel Vorcaro for a film about the former president.

item.title: ‘Tem de perguntar a ele’, diz Michelle Bolsonaro sobre relação de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro declined to comment on the crisis involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, stating that Flávio should be asked directly. She said she participates in political events when possible, such as the launch of Maria Amélia’s pre-candidacy, and that her priority is caring for Jair Bolsonaro. Two opinion polls this week are testing her potential 2026 presidential run, with AtlasIntel showing 23.4% support in a first-round scenario, behind Lula’s 47%.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula é visto como o mais experiente; Flávio Bolsonaro mais moderno e inovador
item.description: Lula is seen as the most experienced candidate by 55% of voters, with a 37-point lead over Flávio Bolsonaro on this trait. Flávio Bolsonaro leads in perceptions of modernity and innovation, with 31% versus Lula’s 26%. Among unaffiliated voters, Lula maintains an experience advantage (52% vs 8%), while Flávio remains the top choice for innovation (22% vs 11%).

item.title: Congresso se prepara para derrubar veto de Lula e liberar doações durante campanha eleitoral
item.description: Congress is preparing to overturn President Lula’s veto on a provision allowing donations during the 2026 electoral campaign, effectively bypassing the 'electoral blackout' period that prohibits resource transfers and donations three months before elections. The measure, previously used under Bolsonaro in 2022, requires a counterpart from recipient municipalities and is part of a broader deal to accelerate parliamentary amendment payments, with over R$ 25.97 billion already released in 2025. Although the executive called the provision unconstitutional, it has allowed its base to overturn the veto to appease mayors gathered in Brasília for the March of Mayors.

item.title: A reação de Michelle Bolsonaro ao ser perguntada sobre ligação de Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro declined to comment publicly on the controversy involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating the matter should be addressed directly with the senator. She made the remark while leaving the event launching Maria Amélia’s pre-candidacy in Brasília on Tuesday, March 19, 2024.

item.title: “Impunidade”, diz TI Brasil sobre minirreforma eleitoral da Câmara
item.description: Transparency International – Brazil criticized the approval of the urgency of PL 4822/2025 by the Chamber of Deputados, stating that the electoral mini-reform seeks to guarantee impunity for parties that committed irregularities in past elections. The organization warns that changes to party accounting could weaken oversight and transparency in campaign financing.

item.title: Michelle evita comentar relação de Flávio com Vorcaro: 'Tem que perguntar para ele'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro avoided commenting on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's involvement with banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating that he should address the matter himself. Her remarks came during the launch of Maria Amélia's pre-candidacy for federal deputy in the Federal District. Flávio had previously admitted to meeting Vorcaro after his release from prison, following a leaked audio in which he demanded overdue payments for a film about Jair Bolsonaro, causing damage to his presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Bancada do agro retoma a atitude de 'passar a boiada' e faz semana de destruição ambiental
item.description: The agribusiness bloc in Congress has resumed the practice of 'passing the cattle herd,' approving anti-environmental measures during 'Agribusiness Week,' taking advantage of public attention focused on the Banco Master scandal and Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy. Despite the sector's reliance on a balanced environment, lawmakers continue to prioritize productive interests over environmental preservation, echoing the logic promoted by Ricardo Salles during the Bolsonaro government.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio avaliam que ele precisa sair do 'inferno astral'; caso contrário, pode se tornar um candidato inviável
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) say he must escape his 'astral hell' after a tumultuous day marked by controversial visits to banker Daniel Vorcaro, under house arrest, and revelations about foreign funding for the film 'Dark Horse', which raised doubts about his electoral viability. They warn that without change, Flávio risks becoming an unviable candidate due to growing scrutiny and potential Federal Police investigations into his ties with Vorcaro.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula se reúne com o comitê de prevenção a feminicídios
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is attending the meeting of the governing committee of the National Pact for the Prevention of Femicide, scheduled for today at 9:30 a.m. at the Planalto Palace. The event marks the 100-day milestone of the Brazil Pact Among the Three Powers to Combat Femicide, launched in February, and will present a review of implemented actions focused on prevention, protection networks, and perpetrator accountability. The pact, under the motto 'All for All,' coordinates efforts between the federal government, states, municipalities, and the Federal District to combat femicide and expand public policies on shelter, protection, and justice.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Flávio admite encontro com Vorcaro, e Lula segue planejando ‘bondades’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro admitted to a personal meeting with Daniel Vorcaro in São Paulo in November 2023, while the former Master owner was wearing an electronic ankle monitor, reinforcing that his pre-campaign remains active despite the fallout. Meanwhile, the Lula government continues planning potential adjustments to the Bolsa Família program this election year, although the economic team denies the hypothesis, with internal discussions depending on available budget space throughout 2024.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': quem é Karina da Gama, empresária ligada a contrato de R$ 108 milhões da Prefeitura de SP e filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Karina Ferreira da Gama, a businesswoman and journalist linked to federal deputy Mario Frias, is under investigation for alleged irregularities in a R$108 million contract with São Paulo City Hall through her NGO Instituto Conhecer Brasil, aimed at installing public Wi-Fi points. She also heads Go Up Entertainment, the producer of the unreleased Bolsonaro biopic 'Dark Horse', despite having no prior film releases in Brazil or abroad. Investigations by the São Paulo Public Prosecutor’s Office and Civil Police cite lack of competitive bidding and the NGO’s inexperience in telecommunications, raising prospects of criminal charges.

item.title: Malafaia muda o tom após novas revelações da relação entre Flávio e Vorcaro: 'Se tiver mais coisa, será difícil apoiar'
item.description: Silas Malafaia, a pastor and Bolsonaro family ally, stated that new revelations about Flávio Bolsonaro’s relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro could undermine evangelical support for his potential 2026 presidential bid. He warned that further disclosures would make his support difficult to sustain, marking a shift in tone toward Bolsonaro’s son. The comment reflects growing concern among evangelical leaders over scandals involving Bolsonaro-aligned figures.

item.title: Como o PL explica as caras constrangidas na foto com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) explained that the constipated expressions seen in photos and videos with Flávio Bolsonaro stemmed from internal discomfort after he disclosed Daniel Vorcaro’s financing of the film about Jair Bolsonaro and his visit to the ex-banker’s home, already under restrictive measures. The revelation created tension among attendees, as the scheme involves potential campaign irregularities and association with figures under investigation. The subscriber-only article details the awkward atmosphere as a reflection of internal division and concern within the party over the political and legal implications of the case.

item.title: Lula aparece à frente de Flávio no 1º e 2º turnos no Ceará
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro in Ceará in both the first and second rounds, with 60% and 63% versus 21% and 27%, respectively. The Real Time Big Data survey, conducted May 18–19, 2026, has a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. The poll was conducted after the scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro’s audio requesting money from Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Charge do JCaesar: 20 de maio
item.description: The JCaesar cartoon published on May 20, 2026, addresses the Brazilian political landscape with humor, mentioning former minister Joaquim Barbosa in an electoral context. The piece satirizes public figures and the current political environment without delving into specific policy proposals.

item.title: PT e PL deram aval para pacote de bondades a partidos; veja bastidores
item.description: The PT and PL gave approval for the rapid passage of a bill creating a package of benefits for political parties, backed by most of the Centrão. The proposal, negotiated in secrecy and driven by Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), aims to relieve parties’ astronomical debts, including the PT’s R$ 18.3 million in federal debt. The measure was approved in a single day after weeks of closed-door talks, with the PT justifying its support by arguing that electoral fines alone are insufficient and often abusive.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala de dinheiro do Master e deixa aliados desconfiados
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the Liberal Party’s presidential candidate, faces ally distrust as he attempts to explain receiving R$ 61 million from Daniel Vorcaro, the former owner of Banco Master, jailed for billion-dollar fraud. He promised to detail the money’s origin within 30 days but has given contradictory accounts of meetings with Vorcaro, including one under house arrest, after previously denying any relationship. His effort to rally party legislators behind his candidacy failed, leaving allies unconvinced and wary of further uncertainty amid the financial scandal.

item.title: Capitão Wagner e Cid Gomes lideram cenários ao Senado no Ceará
item.description: Cid Gomes (PSB) and Captain Wagner (União Brasil) lead in voter intention scenarios for the Senate in Ceará, according to a Real Time Big Data poll released on May 20, 2026. The survey interviewed 1,600 people between May 18–19, with a 2 percentage point margin of error and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Michelle chama Moraes de “irmão em Cristo” e irrita bolsonaristas
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro irrited part of Bolsonaro's base by calling Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes a 'brother in Christ' in a publicly shared video. She made the statement after Moraes allowed Jair Bolsonaro access to a hairdresser, commenting that the former president now had a 'trimmed, neat' hairstyle. The remark drew backlash from hardline supporters who view Moraes as a political enemy.

item.title: O agrado de Mário Frias a Daniel Vorcaro e o alívio de Valdemar no PL
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL party, expressed relief after confirming André do Prado was selected to run for Senate in São Paulo, avoiding the candidacy of Mário Frias, whose ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro — implicated in allegations of financial transfers to the Dark Horse film production — could jeopardize the party's electoral prospects. Frias had publicly thanked Vorcaro for supporting the Bolsonaro biopic, calling it a 'miracle' and 'matter of divine justice,' raising concerns within the PL about the risks of association with controversial financial dealings.

item.title: A grande vantagem de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads the presidential race in Ceará with 60% of voting intentions in the first round, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 21%. In the second round, the president's advantage increases to 63% against Bolsonaro's 27%. Lula's government is approved by 66% of Ceará voters, with 43% rating his administration as 'excellent' or 'good'.

item.title: Capitão Wagner e Cid Gomes são favoritos na disputa pelo Senado no Ceará, indica pesquisa
item.description: Capitão Wagner (União Brasil) and Cid Gomes (PSB) lead Senate race intentions in Ceará, according to Real Time Big Data poll. In all tested scenarios, they occupy the top two positions, with Wagner ranging from 19% to 21% and Cid at 21%. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters between May 18–19, with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: UNE leva ‘pixuleco’ de Flávio Bolsonaro vestido de rato e com R$ 143 milhões a ato em SP
item.description: UNE students hold a public demonstration at Largo da Batata in São Paulo, featuring six-meter inflatable rats representing Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro holding a 'pixuleco' of R$143 million, protesting the deterioration of student aid and budget cuts affecting thousands of university students in São Paulo state universities.

item.title: Centro Cultural Coreano amplia presença na Virada Cultural paulista
item.description: The Korean Cultural Center in Brazil will participate in the 21st Virada Cultural of São Paulo from May 22 to 25, featuring K-pop performances including the boyband 1VERSE, the national final of the K-Pop Festival 2026, a K-Beauty fair, Korean food tastings, and traditional music activities. Events will take place on Avenida Paulista and in Bom Retiro, in partnership with the City of São Paulo, aiming to expand public engagement with various aspects of South Korean culture.

item.title: Pacote eleitoreiro de Lula bate R$ 190 bi em ano eleitoral
item.description: The Lula government announced 14 measures in 2026 with a total financial impact of R$187.4 billion, aimed at regaining voter support. These include expanding the income tax exemption bracket and financing programs for heavy vehicles. The package is seen as an electoral strategy in an election year.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 50,4% e aprovado por 46,1%, diz Vox
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll released on May 20, 2026 shows that 50.4% of Brazilians disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government, while 46.1% approve. The survey has a margin of error of 2.15 percentage points and is registered with the TSE under BR-02416/2026. The study was conducted after the audio scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro requesting money from Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A estratégia de sobrevivência de Flávio Bolsonaro e os fantasmas que o assombram
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces new backlash after admitting he personally contacted Daniel Vorcaro to demand money promised in audio recordings and visited his home while Vorcaro was under house arrest. The PGR is analyzing a request to block box office revenue from the film 'Dark Horse', funded by Vorcaro, as allies downplay the scandal and await Friday’s Datafolha poll to gauge political fallout. The lingering question remains: 'Is there more?' — hinting at potential further revelations beyond the Vorcaro case, tied to his history as a state deputy in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Zema, Renan e Caiado usam estratégias distintas para explorar envolvimento de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) renewed his criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after the senator confirmed visiting former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro in November, stating the explanations were unconvincing and that credibility is essential to govern. Zema, who previously said the matter was 'closed,' reiterated he had no contact with Vorcaro and compared the current political climate to 2018, when he was elected governor of Minas Gerais as a liberal alternative to the right. His allies say the immediate goal is to elevate him to national leadership, despite backlash from Bolsonaro supporters following his initial criticism.

item.title: Bastidor: ‘Dark Horse’ teve multa de R$ 1 milhão contra vazamentos, Flávio no set e ator ‘paranoico’
item.description: The filming of 'Dark Horse', a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro's life, was marked by extreme secrecy measures, including a R$1 million contractual penalty for leaks, bans on cell phones, and thorough searches of extras. Flávio and Carlos Bolsonaro visited the set only once, during the scene depicting Adélio Bispo's arrest after the 2018 stabbing. Actor Jim Caviezel, who plays Bolsonaro, exhibited paranoid behavior due to fears of assassination, worsened by the 2025 death of conservative activist Charlie Kirk, and demanded armed security from retired police officers, leading to on-set conflicts and tension.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: Produtora de longa sobre Bolsonaro nunca fez nenhum filme
item.description: Journalist Karina Ferreira da Gama, owner of Go Up Entertainment — the producer behind the controversial film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro — has never released any film in Brazil or abroad, nor through her other registered companies: Go7 Assessoria and Instituto Conhecer Brasil. The article reveals that none of the three entities linked to her have any registered audiovisual productions with Ancine, raising doubts about the legitimacy of the producer behind the project.

item.title: Ricardo Salles sobre relação de Flávio Bolsonaro com Daniel Vorcaro: 'É no mínimo imoral'
item.description: Ricardo Salles, federal deputy from Novo and Senate pre-candidate in São Paulo, criticized the relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, calling it 'at least immoral'. Salles affirmed he is maintaining his pre-candidacy, which could split the right in the state.

item.title: Lula veta destinar 5% de multas de trânsito a Fundo de Segurança Pública
item.description: President Lula fully vetoed the bill that would have allocated 5% of traffic fine revenues to the National Public Security Fund, citing unconstitutionality and conflict with public interest due to the lack of a five-year limit and missing budgetary impact assessment. The proposal, approved by the Chamber in April, aimed to fund traffic infrastructure and agent training. The veto was published in the Official Gazette on May 20, 2026.

item.title: Luiz Henrique 'furando a bolha', queda de João Pedro e ascensão de Neymar, Endrick e Rayan: a convocação através do atacômetro
item.description: The Brazilian national team's World Cup squad was determined by the Atacômetro, which tracked attackers' performances since November. Vini Jr and Raphinha led the rankings, while Igor Thiago surprised by rising to the podium, Neymar showed strong late growth, and João Pedro declined after a strong start. Luiz Henrique finished 13th and was omitted.

item.title: Com Move Brasil, Lula busca apoio de motoristas de aplicativo e amplia crédito do BNDES com o Tesouro
item.description: President Lula announced the Move Brasil Táxi e Aplicativos program, a provisional measure offering subsidized credit with below-market interest rates for taxi and app-based drivers to purchase or replace vehicles. The initiative, operated by the BNDES using Treasury funds, is the third such program and aims to strengthen support among popular sectors five months ahead of the 2026 elections, as part of efforts to rebuild relations with platform workers after the failed attempt to regulate the sector.

item.title: Menções negativas a Flávio Bolsonaro disparam após revelação de relação com Vorcaro e causam desgaste na imagem da campanha
item.description: The revelation of Flávio Bolsonaro's relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, triggered a 13.5-point percentage increase in negative social media mentions, rising from 40.5% to 54% in one week. Although his image suffered, his follower base continued growing at the same pace, and his defensive video became the second-most viewed post on his profile.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio admitem rever apoio à candidatura à Presidência se surgirem novos fatos sobre caso Master
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro privately admit they may withdraw support for his presidential candidacy if new revelations emerge that broaden the perceived scope of his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro beyond the financing of the film 'Dark Horse'. The core concern is the erosion of credibility due to Bolsonaro’s prior denials of contact with Vorcaro, later contradicted by emerging evidence. While the current situation is seen as politically manageable, allies fear additional facts could render his candidacy 'unviable'.

item.title: Aliados avaliam que Flávio não suporta novo desgaste e pressionam por distanciamento de Castro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro assess that his presidential pre-campaign cannot withstand further political damage and are pressuring him to distance himself from Cláudio Castro, following a meeting that revealed his personal encounter with detained banker Daniel Vorcaro. The main concern is avoiding new leaks or revelations that could harm the candidacy, particularly amid the PF operation targeting Castro over suspicions of fiscal fraud and money laundering linked to the Refit group.

item.title: Cúpula do PL vê prazo de 15 dias para avaliar viabilidade da candidatura de Flávio após conversas com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed he requested money from banker Daniel Vorcaro for a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro and visited Vorcaro after his arrest, despite the banker wearing an electronic ankle monitor. The revelation triggered internal pressure within the PL and raised doubts about the viability of Flávio’s 2026 presidential bid, prompting the party to set a 15-day deadline to assess the scandal’s impact.

item.title: Caviezel tinha medo de facada de verdade em gravação e pediu 'plano de evacuação' quando Trump ameaçou invadir Venezuela
item.description: Actor Jim Caviezel, who portrayed Jair Bolsonaro in the film 'Dark Horse', expressed personal security concerns during filming in Brazil, including fear of real attacks and requesting an evacuation plan, following a Rio police operation that left 122 dead. He left the set early and was replaced by a stunt double, with the production implementing daily bag checks and strict security protocols due to the politically charged environment and the film’s association with controversial figures.

item.title: Maioria dos avatares políticos criados por IA nas redes não informa uso da tecnologia, diz estudo
item.description: A study by the Elections Observatory found that 61% of AI-generated political avatars on social media between January 2025 and April 2026 failed to disclose their artificial origin, violating TSE rules. Of the 18 cases identified, 14 (78%) contained political misinformation, with notable profiles like 'Dona Maria' and 'Seu Zé da Feira' spreading content mainly on TikTok and Instagram.

item.title: Após encontro entre Lula e Trump, EUA e Brasil têm reunião sobre tarifas
item.description: The U.S. and Brazil held a first meeting on tariffs following the May 7 meeting between Presidents Lula and Trump. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said he met with Minister Márcio Elias Rosa of the Mdic on Tuesday, May 19.

item.title: Brasil e EUA têm 1ª reunião sobre tarifas 12 dias após encontro Lula-Trump
item.description: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer announced the first meeting with Brazilian Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services Márcio Fernando Elias Rosa to discuss a trade agreement that would avoid new U.S. tariffs on Brazil. The meeting took place 12 days after the Lula-Trump encounter.

item.title: Até onde a elite vai com os Bolsonaro?
item.description: Part of Brazil's economic and political elite shows leniency toward instabilities caused by the Bolsonaro family, particularly by waiting to see if Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy remains viable despite daily evidence of his ties to Daniel Vorcaro. This reflects a pattern of exceptional tolerance not seen with other political groups, even amid recurring scandals. The article frames this as a renewed, though not new, phenomenon in the relationship between established power and the Bolsonaro clan.
